cases.title: Add Bookmark to Specific Location
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark can be added into a specific target location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Delete Bookmarks from File and Access Points
cases.description: Verify that deleted bookmarks are properly removed from the bookmarks file and no longer displayed in any access points or UI elements.

cases.title: Add and Delete Bookmarks from Personal Toolbar
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be successfully added to and deleted from the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Insert New Bookmark Folder
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder can be inserted into the bookmarks hierarchy at root or nested levels.

cases.title: Launch Bookmark via Double-Click
cases.description: Verify that double-clicking on a bookmark launches the associated URL in a browser window.

cases.title: Default Bookmarks Link Validation
cases.description: Verify that all links within the default bookmarks file packaged with the browser are valid and accessible.

cases.title: Save Changes to Bookmark Item
cases.description: Verify that modifications to a bookmark item are saved successfully without loss of item integrity.

cases.title: Delete Bookmark Folder
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks folder can be deleted along with its hierarchy contents.

cases.title: Add and Delete Bookmark Separators
cases.description: Verify that bookmark separators can be added and deleted correctly at various positions in the list.

cases.title: Persist Bookmark Changes over Restart or Crash
cases.description: Verify that bookmark changes remain saved and intact over a browser restart or unexpected crash.

cases.title: Negative Test for View Properties
cases.description: Verify negative test behavior where view properties are restricted or denied for bookmarks, folders, and separators.

cases.title: Inline Renaming of Bookmarks
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be renamed inline directly in the UI without opening the bookmarks properties dialog.

cases.title: Find Bookmarks Using Custom Keyword
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be searched and found using user-defined custom keywords.

cases.title: Sort and Reverse-Sort Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be sorted and reverse-sorted properly per column.

cases.title: Resize Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns are resizable to show or hide more entry details.

cases.title: Show and Hide Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that individual bookmark columns can be toggled between visible and hidden states.

cases.title: Bulk Deletion of Several Bookmarks
cases.description: Verify that multiple bookmarks can be deleted simultaneously in a single bulk operation.

cases.title: Prevent Invalid Drag-and-Drop on Self or Relatives
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto itself, its immediate parent, or its child.

opinions.feedback: All proposed high-level test cases are well-defined, distinct, cover the requirements comprehensively, and are fully testable without any blockers.
All cases and expected behaviors accurately follow the requirements and their cited IDs. No blockers found.

analysis.analysis: R-001: Testable behavior: Adding a bookmark to a specific hierarchy location. Boundaries: Valid/invalid target folders, root vs subfolder. Normal: Successfully adds to target. Abnormal: Target folder does not exist. Ambiguity: What defines specific location format? R-002: Testable behavior: Deleting bookmarks from file and access points. Boundaries: Single, multiple, all bookmarks. Normal: Removed from file and UI. Abnormal: File locked or inaccessible. Ambiguity: None. R-003: Testable behavior: Personal toolbar add/delete operations. Boundaries: Empty toolbar, full toolbar overflow. Normal: Toolbar updates instantly. Abnormal: Drag-and-drop failure. Ambiguity: Toolbar capacity limits not specified. R-004: Testable behavior: Inserting new bookmark folders into hierarchy. Boundaries: Nested folders, root level. Normal: Folder created correctly. Abnormal: Duplicate folder names. Ambiguity: Maximum nesting depth not defined. R-005: Testable behavior: Launching bookmarks via double-click. Boundaries: Valid URLs, invalid URLs, empty URLs. Normal: Opens in browser window. Abnormal: Browser fails to load or blocks popup. Ambiguity: Active window vs new tab/window not specified. R-006: Testable behavior: Validating default packaged bookmarks links. Boundaries: All default links checked. Normal: All links return 200 OK. Abnormal: Broken links (404, timeout). Ambiguity: Frequency of link validity checks. R-007: Testable behavior: Saving bookmark edits without integrity loss. Boundaries: Special characters in names/URLs, max length fields. Normal: Changes persist accurately. Abnormal: Corruption on save. Ambiguity: Integrity definition criteria. R-008: Testable behavior: Deleting bookmark folders. Boundaries: Empty folder vs folder with contents. Normal: Folder and its contents removed or handled safely. Abnormal: Orphaned child items. Ambiguity: Cascading delete behavior for non-empty folders. R-009: Testable behavior: Adding and deleting bookmark separators. Boundaries: Start, middle, end of lists. Normal: Separator added/removed correctly. Abnormal: Multiple consecutive separators. Ambiguity: None. R-010: Testable behavior: Persistence of changes over restart or crash. Boundaries: Graceful restart vs abrupt crash/kill process. Normal: State restored accurately. Abnormal: Data loss or corruption on crash. Ambiguity: Crash recovery mechanism details. R-011: Testable behavior: Negative test for view properties on bookmarks, folders, and separators. Boundaries: Unsupported property views. Normal: Properties correctly restricted/denied. Abnormal: Properties incorrectly exposed. Ambiguity: Which specific properties are tested. R-012: Testable behavior: Inline renaming without properties dialog. Boundaries: Empty name, extremely long name. Normal: Renames directly in UI tree. Abnormal: Escape key cancels, invalid characters. Ambiguity: Commit action (Enter key vs blur). R-013: Testable behavior: Finding bookmarks via custom keyword. Boundaries: Unique keyword, duplicate keyword, non-existent keyword. Normal: Resolves to correct bookmark. Abnormal: Multiple matches behavior. Ambiguity: Keyword conflict resolution. R-014: Testable behavior: Column sorting and reverse-sorting. Boundaries: Alphabetical, numerical, date columns. Normal: Sorts ascending and descending. Abnormal: Unsortable columns. Ambiguity: Secondary sort criteria. R-015: Testable behavior: Resizing bookmark columns. Boundaries: Minimum width, maximum width. Normal: Columns resize smoothly. Abnormal: Clipping issues. Ambiguity: Auto-fit behavior. R-016: Testable behavior: Showing and hiding bookmark columns. Boundaries: All columns hidden vs all visible. Normal: UI updates correctly. Abnormal: Mandatory column hidden. Ambiguity: Persistence of column visibility state. R-017: Testable behavior: Bulk deletion of several bookmarks simultaneously. Boundaries: All selected, mixed selection (folders and bookmarks). Normal: All selected items deleted. Abnormal: Partial deletion failure. Ambiguity: Undo behavior for bulk deletes. R-018: Testable behavior: Preventing drop onto self, immediate parent, or child. Boundaries: Self-drop, parent-drop, child-drop. Normal: Drop rejected and prevented. Abnormal: Circular hierarchy reference created. Ambiguity: Visual feedback during invalid drop.
